rules: Every listed agent must approve the same exact contentHash.
All 49 non-publisher agents must approve before Publisher can approve.
Publisher approval must be last, after all other agents have approved.
Any content or metadata change creates a new contentHash and invalidates all previous approvals.
Any PENDING, REVISE, BLOCK, missing, stale, or malformed approval blocks publication.
Approvals must include approvedAt and evidence/notes for auditability.
All normal QA gates must also be PASS.
professionalExecution must be PASS before any approval envelope can unlock publishing.
master-integrity-auditor must verify that the final media is not a legacy or substituted asset and matches the approved hash and metadata.
Production volume targets and publishing times never override quality or approval requirements.
Development reviews are not release approvals; no release vote may be recorded before MASTER_READY.

MASTER_READY requires an actual immutable assembled final video plus final audio, captions/lyrics, thumbnail, metadata, rights manifest, theology/fact evidence, full-watch evidence, safe-zone/export evidence, and master hash.
TECHNICAL_MASTER and CREATIVE_MASTER must both be PASS before release voting begins.
Every release agent evaluates the actual final master, not merely prompts, scripts, storyboards, specifications, or component assets.
Any legitimate single BLOCK or REVISE keeps publishing locked regardless of the other votes.
Publisher has no repair, substitution, recompression, or metadata-edit authority; it may only PUBLISH the exact certified master or RETURN_TO_PRODUCTION.
A zero-upload day is valid; quotas, cadence, and scheduled slots never justify releasing a weaker master.
